UI_ALC_LfBarkCold: A bit chilly. Throw some wood on the fire.
UI_ALC_LfBarkHungry: My stomach's growling. When's there going to be some real food?
UI_ALC_LfBarkGood: It's good here. Warm, our people around, a roof over our heads.
UI_ALC_LfBarkScared: My hands are still shaking after the raid.
UI_ALC_LfBarkWalls: The fence is a bit flimsy. You sleep with one eye open.
UI_ALC_LfBarkHome: I keep thinking about home. I wonder what it's like there now.
UI_ALC_LfBarkBored: Boring. Wish there were some work to do.
UI_ALC_LfBarkSad: Ah, this isn't how I pictured it all.
UI_ALC_LfBarkJoke1: At least the zombies don't complain about the food.
UI_ALC_LfBarkJoke2: Hear that scraping behind the fence? That's not zombies, that's my jokes.
UI_ALC_LfBarkJoke3: Alive - that's already good. Fed - almost a holiday.
UI_ALC_LfBarkJoke4: They say the grass is greener next door. But our fence is higher.
UI_ALC_LfBarkOptimist: We'll pull through, folks. It's not our first day out here!
UI_ALC_LfBarkGrumbler: The same porridge again. Could at least toss in some salt.
UI_ALC_LfBarkLoner: It's noisy around you lot. I'll sit off to the side.
UI_ALC_LfBarkSocial: Let's sing something, shall we? It's more fun together.
UI_ALC_LfBarkWorkaholic: My hands itch with nothing to do. What else is there to fix?
UI_ALC_LfBarkFeast: To the camp! May it stand for many more years!
UI_ALC_LfBarkVictory: We held them off! And lost no one. Keep it up!
UI_ALC_LfBarkArrive: Hello everyone. I hope I'll be of use.
UI_ALC_LfBarkWelcome: Welcome, %1! Have a seat by the fire.
UI_ALC_LfBarkMuster: Good morning, camp. What's on for today?
UI_ALC_LfBarkSleep: Time to hit the sack. Tomorrow's packed with work.
UI_ALC_LfBarkGrumble: I'm sick of all this. I won't last long like this.

UI_ALC_PgD_rotation: Beds rotate crops, the soil doesn't get depleted. Harvest grows.
UI_ALC_PgD_sorting: Items are split into rags, metal and wood. Recycling goes faster.
UI_ALC_PgD_sawmill: Your own saw and workbench for planks. Building speeds up.
UI_ALC_PgD_compost: Fertilizer and plastic sheeting over the beds. Harvest even higher.
UI_ALC_PgD_forge: Scrap goes into the furnace, nails are forged on site. Recycling even faster.
UI_ALC_PgD_logistics: Cargo is moved on schedule, storage stays in order. Building and trade pay off more.
UI_ALC_PgD_watch: Sentries are trained to hold the post and sound the alarm. Defense grows.
UI_ALC_PgD_night: Night shifts, with fires burning at the posts. Camp defense and morale rise.
UI_ALC_PgD_works: Barricades and cover by the gates. Defense is noticeably stronger.
UI_ALC_PgD_signal: Rattles, lanterns and signal codes. The alarm travels instantly.
UI_ALC_PgD_drill: Drills and target practice on the range. The camp's best defense.
UI_ALC_PgD_firstaid: Everyone can apply a bandage. The wounded recover faster.
UI_ALC_PgD_hygiene: Soap, buckets and a waste pit. Orderlies work faster.
UI_ALC_PgD_infirmary: A separate room with cots for the sick. Healing is even faster.
UI_ALC_PgD_comfort: A stove, benches and curtains. People feel calmer, the camp more cheerful.
UI_ALC_PgD_evenings: Songs, stories and a shared table in the evenings. People are happier.

UI_ALC_CnH_trader: the trader will leave, nothing will change.
UI_ALC_CnX_trader_d: The deal is done. Gave: %1. Got: %2. Camp reputation +%3.
UI_ALC_CnX_trader_db: The deal is done. Gave: %1. Got: %2. The trader has heard of your honesty and threw in extra: %3.
UI_ALC_CnX_trader_n: You refused to trade. The trader shrugged and rolled his cart on.
UI_ALC_CnX_trader_t: The trader waited for no answer and moved on.
UI_ALC_CnD_wounded: A wounded traveler lies at the gate. He breathes heavily and begs for help, and the people look to you.
UI_ALC_CnO_wounded_1: Treat him with medicine. He'll most likely recover and show his gratitude.
UI_ALC_CnO_wounded_2: Feed him and give him water, no medicine. With luck, he'll leave on his own two feet.
UI_ALC_CnO_wounded_3: Drive him from the gate: we have troubles enough of our own.
UI_ALC_CnH_wounded: the traveler won't last till morning, reputation will drop.
UI_ALC_CnX_wounded_1a: The traveler recovered and left, thanking you every way he could. Reputation +%1, morale rises.
UI_ALC_CnX_wounded_1b: The traveler recovered and left his supplies in gratitude: %1. Reputation +%2.
UI_ALC_CnX_wounded_1c: The wounds were too severe, the traveler died. The people are disheartened, morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnX_wounded_2a: The traveler caught his breath, ate and left on his own two feet. Reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_wounded_2b: The traveler took a turn for the worse and wandered off who knows where. You did what you could. Reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_wounded_3a: You drove the traveler away. The people avert their eyes. Reputation %1, morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnX_wounded_t: While you deliberated, the traveler fell silent at the gate, and by morning he was gone. Reputation %1, morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnD_stash: A map marked with an X turned up among a recent guest's things: a stash a couple of hours' walk from camp. Maybe it's empty, maybe it's an ambush.
UI_ALC_CnO_stash_1: A small outing: two settlers traveling light. We'll lose half a day's work, but there's a chance at loot.
UI_ALC_CnO_stash_2: A large party with an escort. Slower and costlier, but safer and with more loot.
UI_ALC_CnO_stash_3: Don't risk it: throw the map in the fire.
UI_ALC_CnH_stash: the map will be stolen or lost, nothing will change.
UI_ALC_CnX_stash_1a: The outing was a success: the stash held: %1. The settlers returned unharmed.
UI_ALC_CnX_stash_1b: The stash was empty: someone cleaned it out before you. A workday wasted, morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnX_stash_1c: On the way back they were ambushed and shot their way out. Ammo lost: %1. The settlers are angry.
UI_ALC_CnX_stash_2a: The party returned with a big haul: %1, %2.
UI_ALC_CnX_stash_2b: The stash was looted long ago. The party returned empty-handed, ammo spent, morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnX_stash_3a: You burned the map. Less risk, but no loot either. A few sigh.
UI_ALC_CnX_stash_t: Someone swiped the map, and while you deliberated, even the memory of the stash was lost.
UI_ALC_CnD_quarrel: %1 and %2 have fallen out over %3 and no longer listen to each other. The rest wait to see whose side you'll take.
UI_ALC_CnO_quarrel_1: Hear out both and judge fairly. It'll take time, but the camp will appreciate it.
UI_ALC_CnO_quarrel_2: Take a side: %1. Quick, but the other may take real offense.
UI_ALC_CnO_quarrel_3: Stay out of it: let them sort it out themselves.
UI_ALC_CnH_quarrel: the quarrel will drag on, morale will drop.
UI_ALC_CnX_quarrel_1a: You heard out both and judged honestly. The quarrel died down, morale rises. Reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_quarrel_1b: Judging honestly didn't work out: the grudge remained. Everyone's slightly displeased.
UI_ALC_CnX_quarrel_2a: %1 is triumphant, %2 sulks. It didn't come to blows, but a bad taste lingers.
UI_ALC_CnX_quarrel_2b: The offense ran too deep: a settler named %1 left the camp. The rest fell quiet.
UI_ALC_CnX_quarrel_3a: You stayed out of it. They quarreled and cooled off on their own, but tension in the camp grows.
UI_ALC_CnX_quarrel_3b: The quarrel turned into a fight and had to be broken up. Work in the camp slumped.
UI_ALC_CnX_quarrel_t: While you kept silent, the quarrel grew and drew in half the camp. Morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnD_rats: Something rustled and gnawed in the storehouse at night, and by morning there were chewed sacks and droppings. If nothing is done, the rats will spoil supplies: %1.
UI_ALC_CnO_rats_1: Set traps and plug the gaps. Not cheap, but reliable.
UI_ALC_CnO_rats_2: Stage a hunt with the whole camp. Cheap, but it takes time and success isn't guaranteed.
UI_ALC_CnO_rats_3: Let it go: rats want to live too.
UI_ALC_CnX_rats_1a: The traps worked, the gaps are sealed. The rats are gone, supplies intact.
UI_ALC_CnX_rats_1b: The rats are gone, but they made off with some supplies first. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_rats_2a: The hunt succeeded: over a dozen rats killed, the storehouse is clean.
UI_ALC_CnX_rats_2b: The rats scattered into the gaps and came back at night. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_rats_3a: The rats feasted all night. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_rats_t: While you were deciding, the rats feasted in the storehouse. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnD_radio: The radio caught a broken signal: someone is calling for help at an old farm a couple of kilometers away. The voice is weak, and it could be a trap.
UI_ALC_CnO_radio_1: Send an armed group with supplies. Risky and costly, but you could save lives.
UI_ALC_CnO_radio_2: Answer by radio: point them to a safe route. Costs nothing, but will it do any good?
UI_ALC_CnO_radio_3: Switch off the radio: getting involved is too dangerous.
UI_ALC_CnH_radio: the signal will cut out, reputation and morale will drop.
UI_ALC_CnX_radio_1a: The group returned with survivors, who shared their supplies: %1. Reputation +%2, morale rises.
UI_ALC_CnX_radio_1b: It was a trap. The group fought its way out but lost more ammo: %1. The people are angry.
UI_ALC_CnX_radio_1c: No one at the farm, but they found an abandoned cache: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_radio_2a: You pointed out the way. The signal never came again, but the people appreciated that you answered. Reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_radio_3a: The radio fell silent. Someone in the camp gives you a grim look. Reputation %1, morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnX_radio_t: The signal cut out while you deliberated. A heaviness hangs over the camp. Reputation %1, morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnD_dayoff: The people are worn out. A delegation asks for a day off: just one day without building, clearing or watch duty.
UI_ALC_CnO_dayoff_1: Grant the day off. Work will slow noticeably for %1 h, but the camp will get a breather.
UI_ALC_CnO_dayoff_2: Grant half a day's rest. A compromise: fewer losses, less joy.
UI_ALC_CnO_dayoff_3: Refuse: there's much to do, no time to rest.
UI_ALC_CnH_dayoff: the people will take a break anyway, work will slump.
UI_ALC_CnX_dayoff_1a: The day off went well: they played cards, mended clothes and caught up on sleep. Morale rose noticeably. Work slowed for %1 h.
UI_ALC_CnX_dayoff_2a: The half day of rest did good. Morale rose, and by evening everyone will be back to work.
UI_ALC_CnX_dayoff_3a: You refused. The people dispersed in silence. Morale dropped.
UI_ALC_CnX_dayoff_3b: You refused. The people dispersed and now work half-heartedly. Morale and work pace dropped.
UI_ALC_CnX_dayoff_t: Getting no answer, the people took a half-day break on their own. Work slumped, and no one said thanks.
UI_ALC_CnD_refugees: Exhausted refugees have come to the gate, %1 of them. They ask not for a place, only for food to carry on.
UI_ALC_CnO_refugees_1: Feed them all their fill. Generous, but it'll get people talking about you.
UI_ALC_CnO_refugees_2: Give a little food for the road.
UI_ALC_CnO_refugees_3: Send them away: we barely have enough ourselves.
UI_ALC_CnH_refugees: the refugees will leave with nothing, reputation will drop.
UI_ALC_CnX_refugees_1a: The refugees ate their fill and left, thanking you every way they could. Reputation +%1, morale rises.
UI_ALC_CnX_refugees_1b: Among the refugees was a craftsman: on leaving, he left something in gratitude: %1. Reputation +%2.
UI_ALC_CnX_refugees_2a: The refugees took the food, bowed and left. Reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_refugees_3a: The refugees turned away in silence and left. The people in the camp frown. Reputation %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_refugees_t: The refugees waited and left with nothing. Ill rumors of you have spread. Reputation %1.
UI_ALC_CnD_doctor: A doctor who wanders from camp to camp has come to yours. For food, he's willing to teach the medics and anyone who wishes to learn.
UI_ALC_CnO_doctor_1: Full course: medics gain 2 skill levels, the rest gain 1.
UI_ALC_CnO_doctor_2: Short lesson: cheaper, medics gain 1 level, the rest half a level.
UI_ALC_CnO_doctor_3: Give the doctor a meal and send him off in peace.
UI_ALC_CnH_doctor: the doctor will leave for another camp.
UI_ALC_CnX_doctor_1a: The course is over. Settlers trained: %1. Healing in the camp has improved noticeably. Reputation +%2.
UI_ALC_CnX_doctor_2a: The short lesson was worthwhile. Settlers trained: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_doctor_3a: The doctor ate, gave his thanks and left. Word of your hospitality has spread. Reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_doctor_t: The doctor didn't wait and left for another camp.
UI_ALC_CnD_garden: Scouts came across an abandoned garden on the outskirts. The beds are overgrown, but there's still something to harvest, and the land can be put back to use.
UI_ALC_CnO_garden_1: Put the garden in order all together: gather the harvest (about %1) and seeds, dig over the beds. It'll take half a day's work.
UI_ALC_CnO_garden_2: Take only what's already ripe (about %1), no fuss.
UI_ALC_CnH_garden: the garden will be ravaged by birds and rats.
UI_ALC_CnX_garden_1a: The garden is cleared. Gathered: %1, %2. The beds are fertilized, the camp's harvests will do better.
UI_ALC_CnX_garden_1b: The garden was badly overgrown, less was gathered than hoped: %1. But the land is prepared.
UI_ALC_CnX_garden_3a: You left the garden. Maybe someone else will find it useful.
UI_ALC_CnX_garden_t: While you deliberated, birds and rats ravaged the garden. Nothing was left.
UI_ALC_CnD_well: An abandoned well was found nearby. There's plenty of water in it, but the frame has rotted and the windlass is broken.
UI_ALC_CnO_well_1: Repair the well: build a new frame and windlass. It needs materials and a little time.
UI_ALC_CnO_well_2: Just bail out the muck and draw water, leave the rest.
UI_ALC_CnO_well_3: Fill in the well so no one falls in.
UI_ALC_CnX_well_1a: The well is repaired. Clean water is close by and the gardens are easier to water: harvests will grow. Morale rises.
UI_ALC_CnX_well_2a: Water was drawn, the well stayed as it was. Nice, but not for long.
UI_ALC_CnX_well_3a: The well was filled in. One hazard fewer.
UI_ALC_CnX_well_t: The well remained abandoned after all.
UI_ALC_CnD_noise: At night, footsteps, snapping branches and muffled voices were heard beyond the fence. The sentries are on edge.
UI_ALC_CnO_noise_1: Send out a patrol. Ammo will be spent, but we'll find out what's there.
UI_ALC_CnO_noise_2: Reinforce the night watch. The sentries won't sleep well, but the camp will stay alert.
UI_ALC_CnO_noise_3: Pay it no mind: could be anything.
UI_ALC_CnH_noise: the night will pass uneasily, theft is possible.
UI_ALC_CnX_noise_1a: The patrol searched the surroundings: wandering creatures. They were lured away. The people are calmer.
UI_ALC_CnX_noise_1b: The patrol found a sack travelers had left behind: %1. Someone was in quite a hurry.
UI_ALC_CnX_noise_1c: The patrol ran into a skirmish. Ammo lost: %1. The sentries came back angry.
UI_ALC_CnX_noise_2a: The night passed quietly: the reinforced watch scared off the uninvited guests. Defense is higher, but the people didn't sleep enough.
UI_ALC_CnX_noise_3a: The noise died down on its own. Nothing happened.
UI_ALC_CnX_noise_3b: In the morning some supplies were missing: something was dragged off in the night. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_noise_t: The night passed uneasily, and in the morning some supplies were missing. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnD_fire: A spark jumped from the campfire and a stack of planks caught fire. The flames grow before your eyes.
UI_ALC_CnO_fire_1: Put it out with water from the stores.
UI_ALC_CnO_fire_2: Beat down the flames with shovels and earth, all together.
UI_ALC_CnO_fire_3: Save the people and belongings, and let the planks burn.
UI_ALC_CnH_fire: the fire will reach the planks (planks burned: %1).
UI_ALC_CnX_fire_1a: The fire was put out almost at once. Planks burned: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_fire_1b: While water was being hauled, the flames had time to spread. Planks burned: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_fire_2a: The flames were smothered with earth, only the edges got scorched. Planks burned: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_fire_2b: The fire proved stronger than the shovels. Planks burned: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_fire_3a: The people are safe, but the plank supply burned up. Planks burned: %1. Morale falls.
UI_ALC_CnX_fire_t: While you deliberated, the fire devoured the planks. Planks burned: %1.
UI_ALC_CnD_thief: A lad was caught in the storehouse with a sack of stolen canned food. He's scrawny, shaking and swears he won't do it again.
UI_ALC_CnO_thief_1: Drive him out in disgrace, to warn off the others.
UI_ALC_CnO_thief_2: Feed him and let him go.
UI_ALC_CnO_thief_3: Make him work off what he stole at the logging site.
UI_ALC_CnH_thief: the kid will break free and run off with the sack (damage: %1).
UI_ALC_CnX_thief_1a: The kid was kicked out. A lesson for the others, but many feel uneasy about it. Reputation %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_thief_2a: The kid ate, burst into tears and ran off. The people approve. Reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_thief_2b: The kid ate and came back by evening with a sack of finds: %1. Reputation +%2.
UI_ALC_CnX_thief_3a: The kid worked a day at the logging site. Logs gathered: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_thief_3b: The kid ran off with a sack of supplies. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_thief_t: The kid broke free and ran off with the sack. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnD_feast: The camp has plenty of supplies, and the people are fired up about a big shared dinner. It's been a while since there was a reason to gather by the fire.
UI_ALC_CnO_feast_1: Throw a feast for the whole camp: songs, tall tales and lots of food.
UI_ALC_CnO_feast_2: A modest dinner by the fire.
UI_ALC_CnO_feast_3: Not now: we need to save our supplies.
UI_ALC_CnH_feast: the celebration will fall through, morale will drop.
UI_ALC_CnX_feast_1a: The feast was a success: singing and laughter late into the night. Morale rose sharply, though work went slower in the morning.
UI_ALC_CnX_feast_2a: A quiet dinner by the fire. The people enjoyed it, morale rose.
UI_ALC_CnX_feast_3a: You put off the dinner. The people sighed and went off to their bunks. Morale dropped.
UI_ALC_CnX_feast_t: The dinner never happened. The people waited for your word and got silence instead. Morale is dropping.
UI_ALC_CnD_alliance: A man from a neighboring group of survivors came to the gate. He offers a pact: share news, help during raids and not fight each other.
UI_ALC_CnO_alliance_1: Form an alliance: exchange patrol routes and set aside ammo for a joint watch.
UI_ALC_CnO_alliance_2: A trade deal only: exchange supplies with no obligations. We'll get: %1, %2.
UI_ALC_CnH_alliance: the messenger will leave offended, reputation will drop.
UI_ALC_CnX_alliance_1a: The alliance is formed. The neighbors will watch the approaches, you watch theirs. Defense grows, reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_alliance_2a: You agreed to trade. The neighbors sent gifts: %1, %2. Reputation +%3.
UI_ALC_CnX_alliance_3a: You refused. The messenger left politely, but without warm words. Reputation -1.
UI_ALC_CnX_alliance_t: The messenger didn't wait for an answer and left, offended. Reputation %1.
UI_ALC_CnD_bandits: An armed gang came up to the gate. The leader smirks: pay for peace, or we'll come at night. The guards await your word.
UI_ALC_CnO_bandits_2: Show force: line up shooters on the wall and refuse.
UI_ALC_CnO_bandits_3: Stall for time and hope they leave.
UI_ALC_CnH_bandits: the bandits will take what they want themselves (damage: %1).
UI_ALC_CnX_bandits_1a: The tribute is paid. The gang left, but the camp's people feel humiliated. Reputation %1, morale is dropping.
UI_ALC_CnX_bandits_2a: The shooters on the wall did their job: the gang judged the risk too great and left. Reputation +%1, morale rises.
UI_ALC_CnX_bandits_2b: It came to a shootout at the gate. The gang was driven off, but ammo spent: %1. The camp is on alert.
UI_ALC_CnX_bandits_3a: The gang loitered at the gate and left: no one was in a hurry to answer.
UI_ALC_CnX_bandits_3b: The gang didn't wait and took what they wanted themselves. Lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_bandits_t: The gang didn't wait and took what they wanted themselves. Lost: %1. Reputation %2.
UI_ALC_CnD_hunters: Hunters came up to the gate with a deer carcass and hares on poles. The meat is fresh, and they ask a fair price for it.
UI_ALC_CnO_hunters_1: Buy the meat for ammo: we'll get about %1.
UI_ALC_CnO_hunters_2: Trade the meat for nails: we'll get about %1.
UI_ALC_CnH_hunters: the hunters will go to the neighbors.
UI_ALC_CnX_hunters_1a: The deal is done, received: %1. The hunters are pleased, the ammo will come in handy for them.
UI_ALC_CnX_hunters_2a: The trade went through, received: %1. The hunters are glad for the nails.
UI_ALC_CnX_hunters_3a: The hunters shrugged and went to the neighbors.
UI_ALC_CnX_hunters_t: The hunters didn't wait and went to the neighbors.
UI_ALC_CnD_storm: A black front of clouds is drawing in from the west, the wind is picking up. If the storm catches us off guard, the roofs, stores and tents will take a beating.
UI_ALC_CnO_storm_1: Secure everything we can: tie down the tarps, brace the walls, cover the supplies.
UI_ALC_CnO_storm_2: Have the whole camp wait it out in shelter, dropping work.
UI_ALC_CnH_storm: the storm will catch us off guard, there will be losses.
UI_ALC_CnX_storm_1a: The storm passed, the camp held. Everything is intact.
UI_ALC_CnX_storm_1b: The storm turned out fiercer than expected: some planks were torn off. Planks lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_storm_2a: Everyone waited it out in shelter, and the storm passed to the side.
UI_ALC_CnX_storm_2b: While sitting in shelter, the wind carried off some of the stores. Planks lost: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_storm_3a: The storm passed to the side. We got lucky.
UI_ALC_CnX_storm_3b: The storm caught the camp off guard: tarps torn off, supplies carried away. Lost: %1, %2. Morale is dropping.
UI_ALC_CnX_storm_t: The storm caught the camp off guard. Lost: %1, %2. Morale is dropping.
UI_ALC_CnD_wreck: Scouts spotted the remains of a convoy on the highway: overturned trucks, burnt-out cabs. There may be parts, metal and something useful there.
UI_ALC_CnO_wreck_1: Send a crew to strip it with a guard. We'll lose half a day of work.
UI_ALC_CnO_wreck_2: Send only scouts to look from a distance.
UI_ALC_CnO_wreck_3: Don't go near it: the place is bad.
UI_ALC_CnH_wreck: others will pick the convoy clean.
UI_ALC_CnX_wreck_1b: The convoy had already been stripped before you. The crew came back with a small haul: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_wreck_1c: There were zombies wandering around the convoy, we had to fight them off. Ammo lost: %1. The people are angry.
UI_ALC_CnX_wreck_2a: The scouts came back with news and a couple of finds: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_wreck_2b: The scouts came back with nothing: it's too crowded there.
UI_ALC_CnX_wreck_3a: You chose not to risk it. The convoy was left to rust.
UI_ALC_CnX_wreck_t: While you were thinking, others picked the convoy clean.
UI_ALC_CnD_crew: A band of wandering carpenters offers help. Work is in full swing on the build site, and extra hands wouldn't hurt.
UI_ALC_CnO_crew_1: Hire them for a day: work will go noticeably faster. You'll have to pay in materials.
UI_ALC_CnO_crew_2: Hire them for half a day for food.
UI_ALC_CnO_crew_3: Refuse: we'll manage on our own.
UI_ALC_CnH_crew: the band will go look for work elsewhere.
UI_ALC_CnX_crew_1a: The band got to work and is working flat out. A full day of work goes noticeably faster. Reputation +1.
UI_ALC_CnX_crew_2a: The carpenters worked half a day for food. Things picked up.
UI_ALC_CnX_crew_3a: The band went to look for work elsewhere.
UI_ALC_CnX_crew_t: The band didn't wait and went to look for work elsewhere.
UI_ALC_CnD_dog: A scrawny dog is hanging around the gate. It looks at you with clever eyes, wags its tail, but won't come close.
UI_ALC_CnO_dog_1: Take it in: feed it and keep it at the camp.
UI_ALC_CnO_dog_2: Chase it off: we have enough troubles of our own.
UI_ALC_CnH_dog: the dog will leave on its own.
UI_ALC_CnX_dog_1a: The dog stayed at the camp. The people cheered up: there's someone to pet now.
UI_ALC_CnX_dog_1b: The dog stayed and turned out to be a keen watchdog: it senses strangers from afar. The people cheered up, defense is higher.
UI_ALC_CnX_dog_2a: The dog was chased off. It left, looking back. The people feel uneasy.
UI_ALC_CnX_dog_t: The dog milled around and left. The people feel a little sad.
UI_ALC_CnD_veteran: A grey-haired veteran with a rifle on his back came up to the gate. He's ready to teach the guards a thing or two, as long as there's something to pay with.
UI_ALC_CnO_veteran_1: Hold combat training: shooting practice and drills. Ammo will be used up, but guards gain 2 skill levels, the rest 1.
UI_ALC_CnO_veteran_2: Ask him to talk tactics for food, without shooting. Guards gain 1 level, the rest half a level.
UI_ALC_CnO_veteran_3: Treat the veteran to a meal and see him off.
UI_ALC_CnX_veteran_1a: The drills went great. Settlers trained: %1. Shooters and guards improved noticeably. Reputation +%2.
UI_ALC_CnX_veteran_2a: The veteran shared a lot of useful things. Settlers trained: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_veteran_3a: The veteran ate, gave his thanks and moved on. Reputation +%1.
UI_ALC_CnX_veteran_t: The veteran stood around and moved on.
UI_ALC_OptHint_pgReadBooks: Settlers read skill books and magazines from storage for progression points. Turn off to keep them from touching the books.
UI_ALC_PgPaceDays: Pace (points per day): about %1. About %2 days to go.
UI_ALC_OptHint_sanitation: Sanitation workers clear away corpses and blood and bury fallen comrades at the cemetery. Cleanliness affects morale and health.
UI_ALC_OptHint_sanitaryRing: How far beyond the camp border sanitation workers search for corpses and blood. They only work where the terrain is loaded.
UI_ALC_SanOff: Sanitation is turned off in the settings.
UI_ALC_SanLineZone: Cleaning zone: %1 by %2 tiles, ring around the camp %3.
UI_ALC_SanLineZoneFlat: Cleaning zone: %1 by %2 tiles, inside the camp only.
UI_ALC_SanLineNobody: No one to clean: at least two settlers are needed.
UI_ALC_SanLineBuried: Comrades buried: %1, graves at the cemetery: %2.
UI_ALC_SanLinePlot: Cemetery: plot %1 by %2 tiles, free spots %3.
UI_ALC_SanLinePlotNone: Cemetery: no suitable spot found yet.
UI_ALC_SanOverviewDirty: Dirty: corpses %1, blood stains %2. Sanitation workers needed.
UI_ALC_SanNoteMemory: %1: a memorial marker was placed at the cemetery, %2.
UI_ALC_SanNoteAftermath: %1: a big clean-up is underway after the raid.
UI_ALC_SanSayCarry: I'll carry him to the cemetery.
UI_ALC_SanSayBody2: Can't leave something like this by the camp.
UI_ALC_SanSayBlood2: Blood needs to be washed off right away.
UI_ALC_Log_san_cemetery: A cemetery was laid out, plot %1 by %2 tiles.
UI_ALC_Log_san_aftermath: After the raid, sanitation workers set to a big clean-up.
UI_ALC_Log_san_filth: The camp is unsanitary: filth builds up faster than it's cleared.
UI_ALC_OptHint_lumber: When planks run short, some settlers cut down trees around the camp and saw the logs into planks. Turn off if planks should come only from stores and finds.
UI_ALC_OptHint_lumberRange: How far from the camp border trees are cut down.
UI_ALC_SupplyOk: Supply is fine: planks %1, nails %2, metal %3.
UI_ALC_SupplyWood: Wood gathering: lumberjacks %1, trees found nearby %2, cut down %3, hauled from the far forest %4 times.
UI_ALC_SupplyNoJacks: No lumberjacks: no one to send or too few people.
UI_ALC_SupplyLumberOff: Logging is turned off in the settings.
UI_ALC_SupplyOther_nails: Nails come from recycling scrap and forging metal: scavengers and workers bring in scrap.
UI_ALC_SupplyOther_metal: Metal comes from scavengers and scrap recycling.
UI_ALC_SupplyOther_rope: Rope comes from scavengers and recycling clothes.
UI_ALC_SanDoingCarry: carrying a body to the cemetery
UI_ALC_CnD_horde: The lookouts spotted a grey moving mass far off on the highway: a horde, hundreds of zombies, and the wind is carrying it toward the camp. It's an hour or two away.
UI_ALC_CnO_horde_1: Lie low: put out the fires, drop work and sit quietly behind the fence. The camp will freeze for a while, but there'll be no noise.
UI_ALC_CnO_horde_2: Draw them off with noise: a couple of shots and a smoke bomb at the far crossroads.
UI_ALC_CnO_horde_3: Change nothing: maybe it'll pass by.
UI_ALC_CnH_horde: the horde will run into the fence, there will be losses and alarm (we'll lose planks: %1).
UI_ALC_CnX_horde_1a: The camp went still. The grey mass passed half a kilometer away, and no one noticed you. The watch held.
UI_ALC_CnX_horde_1b: Part of the horde still turned toward the camp and pressed on the fence. We held, but the fence was patched up: %1.
UI_ALC_CnX_horde_2a: The noise worked: the horde was drawn to the shots and moved on past. Reputation +%1, the people breathe easy.
UI_ALC_CnX_horde_2b: The noise drew the wrong ones: part of the horde turned toward the camp. Ammo lost: %1. Morale is dropping, the guard is on alert.
UI_ALC_CnX_horde_3a: The horde passed to the side. We got lucky.
UI_ALC_CnX_horde_3b: Part of the horde reached the fence. We fought them off, but had to make repairs. Lost: %1. Morale is dropping.
UI_ALC_CnX_horde_t: The horde reached the fence while you were thinking. Lost: %1, morale is dropping.
UI_ALC_NeedsWhere: Bring it to the storage crate: tile %1, %2. Whatever you put there is what the settlers will use up.
UI_ALC_NeedsWhereNone: There's no storage crate yet, the camp will set one up itself.
UI_ALC_NeedsNone: The camp doesn't need anything right now.
UI_ALC_NeedsHint: The list updates itself. When a new need appears, a notification pops up over the character.
UI_ALC_NeedRow_food: Food: enough for %2 days, need about %1 more portions (canned goods, grains, prepared food)
UI_ALC_NeedRow_water: Water: %2 L in storage, need %1 L more (water bottles and canisters)
UI_ALC_NeedsNew: Camp "%1" needs: %2. Bring it to the storage crate.
UI_ALC_NeedsOverview: Camp needs (%1): %2. Details on the Needs tab.
UI_ALC_OptHint_needsAlert: A pop-up message when the camp is short of something and it's worth bringing to the storage crate.
UI_ALC_CnHelp: Click an option line to respond. The cost will be deducted from storage immediately.
UI_ALC_OptHint_sorties: Scavengers head to places where supplies were recently found instead of standing by storage. If turned off, they stay in the camp.
UI_ALC_Act_reset: Demolish all camp buildings and rebuild
UI_ALC_ActHint_reset: Demolishes houses, the fence, watchtowers, gardens and everything else the camp built (some planks will return to storage) and draws up a new plan. Settlers, storage, skills and borders remain. Go up to the camp so it's fully loaded.
UI_ALC_AskReset: Demolish all buildings of camp "%1" and draw up the plan again? Settlers, storage and borders will remain. What was built will be lost.
UI_ALC_ResetDone: Buildings demolished: %1 projects. The camp will draw up a new plan.
UI_ALC_ResetPartial: Projects demolished: %1. Not loaded and remaining: %2. Come closer and repeat.
UI_ALC_ResetBlocked: Storage couldn't be cleared, nothing was demolished.
UI_ALC_Act_zeroclean: Zero cleanup (sweep everything down to the ground)
UI_ALC_ActHint_zeroclean: Demolishes ABSOLUTELY EVERYTHING within the camp borders down to the ground: buildings, scattered furniture, antennas and poles, corpses, items on the ground and blood. Floors and roads remain. Settling into map houses is turned off (otherwise it places furniture again). A few more passes over the next minutes finish cleaning what wasn't loaded. Settlers and storage remain. If Auto-plan is on, the camp will re-plan and rebuild to the current template on clean ground.
UI_ALC_AskZeroClean: Sweep EVERYTHING in camp "%1" down to the ground (buildings, furniture, antennas, corpses, items, blood) and turn off settling into map houses? Settlers and storage will remain.
UI_ALC_ZeroCleanDone: Objects cleared: %1. The site is clean.
UI_ALC_OptHint_wallTier: What the camp fence is built from. Auto: based on the camp level. Affects new fence; an already-built fence can be rebuilt with the demolish-building button on the Settings tab.
UI_ALC_Act_shells: Reset settler shells (if there's panic nearby or they act like zombies)
UI_ALC_ActHint_shells: Brings all settlers to the state of normal friendly NPCs: removes reanimation traits, zombie targeting and crawling from their shells. It also does this automatically every 5 in-game minutes and on settling. Useful if NPCs were reanimated from corpses with a cheat.
UI_ALC_FeatHelp: Separate blocks of the mod. Off by default so as not to touch existing saves. Turn on what you want to try.
UI_ALC_FeatHint_outposts: An add-on over the Project A-Life outpost system. It adds the map's landmark buildings as targets: supermarket, gun store, warehouses. A-Life factions occupy such buildings and fortify them with the mod's standard means: barricaded windows and doors, a barrier at the entrance, stockpiles and a garrison. While this block is off, we don't add our own targets, don't touch Project A-Life settings, and old saves load as before.
UI_ALC_Checkpoint_overview: Checkpoints at the entrance: %1 of %2 (placed outside)
UI_ALC_FeatHint_power: A separate block: power stations appear on the map, each with a coverage circle and consumption within it. Different stations provide different power and radius. A station has a resource and wear: fuel runs out, an overload blows the fuse, equipment wears down, and then the station goes dark until you repair it (replacing the fuse, refueling, maintenance). A camp within a working station's circle counts as powered. While this block is off, nothing is generated and old saves don't change.
UI_ALC_Power_offgrid: Power grid: camp outside station coverage
UI_ALC_Power_oncamp: Power grid: powered by %1, load %2 of %3
UI_ALC_ActHint_regen: Returns the terrain within the camp borders and around it (in whole 8x8 chunks) to its state at map start: the engine regenerates the tiles from the map. EVERYTHING in this zone is erased: buildings, items, loot, corpses and NPCs; settlers are removed, and the camp starts over on the same area. EXPERIMENTAL, make a copy of your save beforehand. Go up to the camp so the zone is loaded.
UI_ALC_AskRegen: Return the terrain of camp %1 to the map default? EVERYTHING in the camp area will be erased: buildings, loot, corpses, NPCs. The camp will start over. Make a copy of your save first!
UI_ALC_RegenDone: Terrain returned to default: chunks %1, settlers removed %2. The camp will start over.
UI_ALC_OptHint_tiers: The settlement develops through tiers (Camp, Outpost, Village, Town, City): as population, size and number of buildings grow, new buildings and districts unlock. Only for new camps.
UI_ALC_LangHint: Click to switch the ALifeCamp language. Auto follows the game's language.
